body.message: Dear Jonathan, Thank you for the referral and for sharing Mr. Jaymin's details. We will have Erica from our Business Development team contact him today to discuss the holiday homes rental potential for the JBR Rimal property and provide the necessary information and quotation. Thank you for thinking of Fam Living, and we appreciate your continued support and referrals. Best Regards, Afifa Al Shami Fam Living
